meta.title: dsh-mcp-adapter
meta.description: Project-level MCP for DeepSeek Harness: discovers MCP servers from the project's .mcp.json and .dsh/mcp-adapter.json plus the global mcp-adapter/mcp.json, starts them lazily and stops them when idle, reaches their tools through one cached-catalog `mcp` proxy tool, and holds project servers until the MCP panel in the conversation header approves them.
